visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all 17 portable, 17 shared and 38 medium-fi frames after the final surface fixes. The full 425.5m flat-roof tower, six-column punched-window cadence, five paired open mechanical bands, cylindrical cores, offset L-shaped 30m podium, southwest arrival canopy and two revolving doors remain present. Dedicated whole-tower views cover every browser level; generic street/block cameras intentionally inspect the lower facade and crop the roof. Final podium frames are complete after separating them from the glass by 3cm. Street window reveals and clipped corner piers now close the unintended oblique gaps. Open mechanical floors remain genuine openings.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: The detailed master and close derivatives reuse the canonical concrete_plain, metal_painted and stone_granite 256px graphs with no embedded images. District additionally declares the registered window_punched graph, repeated as a six-column by 90-row graphic motif, rather than a one-meter physical window. Its generic glass panes are visibly wider than the measured street panes at a close comparison; this district approximation is explicit. Concrete is restrained off-white, glass blue-green and opaque, with reusable metal and granite details. Each master graph was read once; eviction disposed all model geometry.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected every final noon/late, economy/high, silhouette, source-detail, authored LOD-camera and transition frame. The same full tower/podium envelope and all five paired wind bands persist across levels. Skyline uses averaged closed-facade color, district introduces its shared window motif, and street/closeup add measured panes, reveals and frame strips. The visible generic district-to-street pane change is accepted within the 1.6m district error; it is not an exact district reconstruction of ten-foot panes. Four dedicated whole-tower cameras verify every level without roof cropping. Synthetic brownstone context checks scale and style and does not reproduce the surrounding Midtown buildings.

geographicReview.notes: Fresh attributed OSM outline 261499924, tower part 463593207 and 30m podium part 463386820 exactly match the preserved source footprints; main-entry node 5995346749 independently resolves the signed facade. Retained anchor [-73.971850755,40.761695679], heading 1.072509089709 rad gives native +X 28.550 degrees east of north and native -X toward the southwest 56th Street entry. Actually inspected the north-up overlay: the offset shaft and whole L-shaped podium fit without stretching the published 28.5m shaft to the entire site. Perimeter residuals are under 0.15m; accepted map/reconstruction tolerance is 2m and 1 degree. GroundY0 uses terrain contact; absolute street grade is unmeasured. Footprint replacement is disabled.

fidelityReview.notes: The original 292,272-triangle detailed source master is preserved byte-for-byte and remains reproducible from signature-tower-432-park-model.mjs. Authored scope includes the complete shaft, all five paired open mechanical bands, cores, flat roof and adjacent mapped 30m L-shaped podium. It excludes the separately freestanding Park Avenue retail cube and older neighboring buildings, which are not suppressed by footprint replacement. Geometrical rows are not claimed as occupied floors. The 3.048m panes, 0.1016m reveals and 28.5m shaft dimensions guide street and closeup derivatives; district uses an explicitly generic shared window motif. Interior apartments and real street elevations are outside this exterior review.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four pinned derivatives: skyline 994 triangles / 94,740 bytes / one draw; district 3,980 / 343,624 / seven draws; street 11,504 / 949,216 / six draws; closeup 49,736 / 4,432,048 / six draws. Initial skyline plus district totals 438,364 bytes, below the phone and laptop download targets. Whole-asset geometric errors are 1.6m, 1.6m, 1m and 0.15m. Separate vertex streams avoid duplicate GPU uploads. Actual browser fixture captures and shared-geometry disposal pass. Physical phone/laptop timings, nocturnal pixels and real sloping street contact are unmeasured; the master remains separately available at 25,860,028 bytes.

limitations: Complete static medium-fi exterior of the 425.5m square concrete tower and its mapped adjacent L-shaped lower podium, including all five authored double-row open mechanical bands and cylindrical cores, 56th Street arrival and roof. The unchanged 292,272-triangle detailed source master is reproducible. Four separate browser recipes preserve all principal masses and open levels. District uses the reusable 256px window_punched graph at an explicit six-column, 90-geometrical-row motif phase; its generic opening ratio and pane color approximate the building, and graph tiling is not a metric window survey. Street restores every authored square pane and closeup restores intrados, simplified perimeter/hopper frames and core ribs. Centimeter joints, handles, hardware, measured core drums, terrace furnishing, interior fit-out and live tenant signage are outside browser detail. Ninety geometric rows and marketing floor numbers are distinct. Standalone Park Avenue retail cube and neighboring older buildings are independent site structures outside this tower/podium asset and remain eligible for ordinary map rendering; replacement is disabled. No downloaded mesh or copied facade photo is redistributed. Three mapped arrays were freshly confirmed unchanged, and the southwest entry fixes signed orientation. Absolute site elevation, street grade and physical phone/laptop timings remain unmeasured.
